en: The front of the postcard features an illustrated image of a cheerful young girl in a blue polka-dotted dress and pink socks, standing beside an old-fashioned wooden camera on a tripod. The girl is peeking from under the camera's cloth, possibly pretending to be a photographer. There is decorative cursive German text, which along with the image, gives the card a light and nostalgic tone. The reverse side includes handwritten German text, a postage stamp, and postal marks. There is also a printed blue stamp with 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' referring to a museum located in a castle in Bad Pyrmont.
